description: This file defines the DefaultClaimMessageConfig class, which provides configuration for claim message timeouts in the gateway service. It includes methods to instantiate from a Config object, access timeout values, and standard object methods.

classes.name: DefaultClaimMessageConfig
classes.description: Immutable class implementing MessageConfig, providing timeout configuration settings for claim messages.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance from a Config object, using fallback configuration.

methods.name: getDefaultTimeout
methods.description: Returns the default timeout duration for claim messages.

methods.name: getMaxTimeout
methods.description: Returns the maximum timeout duration for claim messages.
